verdict.rationale: Self-serve document automation is a fair question for a law firm serving founders, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an online investor-readiness assessment tool that produces a score and report, plus static downloadable cap table templates. Neither is interactive assembly of real legal documents completed online, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates
